Messages.Author: Name
Messages.Body:
Condemnation: Mute gives a minion -3 votes.

If it is played on a minion who has no votes to begin with, can that minion
vote for a referendum and have his -3 votes subtracted from the total?

Thanks!

Neil

Correct. Similarly, you don't gain blood/pool when struck/bled by
a minion with -1 strength/bleed.

> however, i'd also go with:
> if that minion plays a superior bewitching oration, it'd only bring
> them up to 1 vote.

Correct.
